Noah B: quick note from todays onboarding: we see a repeating token-shift near the 29600-29640 region on a 32k long run when switching between fp16 and int8-channelwise. looks like a RoPE amplitude slip, but could be kv-tiling.
Zara P: can you share the exact flags used?
Noah B: run: `./harness --model nova-32k --quant int8-channelwise --ropescale rescale2 --prefill_stride 64 --capture-kv --job nova-20260325-01`
Mia Nguyen: thanks. paste of the minimal diff from logs:
```
[2026-03-25T13:02:12Z] KV-TILE: tile=29 start=29440 len=1024 checksum=0x8a1b2d
[2026-03-25T13:02:12Z] KV-TILE_DEQ: tile=29 checksum=0x8a1b2d
[2026-03-25T13:02:12Z] KV-TILE: tile=30 checksum=0x4e7c9a
[2026-03-25T13:02:12Z] DIFF first-mismatch tile=30 offset=72 global-token=29672
[2026-03-25T13:02:12Z] INFER(INT8): token=29673 -> "Section" (no dot)
[2026-03-25T13:02:12Z] INFER(FP16): token=29673 -> "Section."
```
DevInfra: note we rolled a memcopy patch last week that touched shard-join ordering; INFRA-6214. confirm job ran on a host without that patch?
Noah B: host is patched. but running again with `--quant-scale-mode global` and `--rotary-interpolate true` now to isolate. job nova-20260325-02 queued.
Zara P: if global scale + interpolate fixes it, we should consider adding a lightweight runtime check that compares per-tile checksums during onboarding.
Mia Nguyen: agree. also try a hybrid run (lower layers fp16) to see if divergence onset moves earlier/later. that helps tell quant rounding cascade vs ropescale.
ci-bot: job nova-20260325-02 started, artifacts streaming to s3://redwood-ci/nova-20260325-02/
Noah B: preliminary: with global-scale+rotary-interpolate mismatch count dropped 5->0 across 8 runs, but tail latency +4%. will add perf/quality tradeoff note to the MR.
Zara P: nice. create ML ticket to add 29-30 tile boundary regression to onboarding checklist and include the sanitized legal prompt we used.
Noah B: creating ML-9450 now. closing thread, will report full eval tomorrow. :thumbsup:
